mention the bot to ask about your projects, and approve the actions that spend credits\n87:- [Preview draft judge grading on one r
ecorded iteration](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/preview-draft-judge-grading-on-one-recorded-iteration.md): Uses
model budget and complete recorded evidence without changing the run verdict. Supply rubric.instructions, optional structured cri
teria, or null for objective-only grading. Continue with the unchanged rubric and returned cursor, sourceHash and reservationId. C
ompleted page retries return cached…\n96:- [Preview a failed-cases rerun](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/preview-
a-failed-cases-rerun.md): What `POST /projects/{projectId}/eval-runs/{runId}/rerun` with `scope: \"failed_cases\"` would execute,
before anything spends. The platform selects every case with a trial that is not completed and passed; cancelled and skipped trial
s do not count. `reasons` and `excluded` count trials; `selectedCase…\n125:- [Mint a model lease for MCPJam-hosted inference](http
s://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/mint-a-model-lease-for-mcpjam-hosted-inference.md): How an SDK eval running OUTSIDE th
e platform (local dev, CI) uses MCPJam-hosted inference on the organization's credits, with no provider key of its own. Authentica
te like any other `/api/v1` route (typically an `sk_` key).\n144:- [Read the organization's spend budget](https://docs.mcpjam.com/
api-reference/catalog/read-the-organizations-spend-budget.md): The ceiling on what this organization may spend on MCPJam-billed wo
rk — chat, evals, judges and computer time — in the current billing window, and how much of it has been spent.\n145:- [Set the org
anization's spend budget](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/set-the-organizations-spend-budget.md): Set or replace the
ceiling. **Requires organization owner or admin.**\n146:- [Remove the organization's spend budget](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-re
ference/catalog/remove-the-organizations-spend-budget.md): Leave the organization uncapped. **Requires organization owner or admin
.**\n147:- [List organizations](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/list-organizations.md): The organizations the caller
belongs to — the source of the `organizationId` that `GET /projects` filters by and `POST /projects` accepts. An API key is bound
to one organization and only ever sees that one. Read-only: organization, member, role and billing changes are not part of the pu
blic API.\n203:- [Request insights for an eval run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/evals/request-insights-for-an-eval-run.m
d): **No credits are consumed** — the model cost is on MCPJam. Runs a model over the finished run and draws on the same shared `in
sightsPerDay` request ledger as swarm and user-testing insights.\n235:- [Set the guest-execution caps](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api
-reference/studies/set-the-guest-execution-caps.md): The spend dial for anonymous visitors. A FULL REPLACEMENT — send every field.
These caps only mean something as a set, and a partial update that raised one while leaving another stale would produce a combina
tion nobody chose.\n245:- [Request insights for the current window](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/request-insights
-for-the-current-window.md): **No credits are consumed** — the model cost is on MCPJam. Runs a model over the study's current wind
ow and draws on the organization's `insightsPerDay` ledger, which counts REQUESTS and is SHARED with eval-run and swarm run insigh
ts, so a request here takes one from there.\n257:- [Get a connection request](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-connect
ions/get-a-connection-request.md): Current state of one connection request. Metered on its own poll budget rather than the shared
per-caller one, so polling on a short interval is expected and will not spend the budget your other calls need. A 429 here means t
he poll interval itself is too fast; honour Retry-After.\n288:- [Get a run's rubric scorecard](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-referen
ce/swarm-insights/get-a-runs-rubric-scorecard.md): The deterministic rubric result for one run. No model, no spend.\n297:- [Start
a Muse connector readiness run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/directory-readiness/start-a-muse-connector-readiness-run.md)
: Grades the saved server against Meta's Muse connector guidelines and returns `202` with a run id. Free: Muse readiness has no AI
observations, so the body has no field that can spend, and no submission mode, which belongs to the OpenAI plugin directory. The
submission-ready verdict stays `incomplete…\n", "exit_code": 0, "status": "completed"}}
